    THE DALE: UNDERWORLD

    Stage 1 — you start as a low-level runner in Rochdale, Greater Manchester. Your phone — the Line — is your business. Customers ring in orders from real streets across town. Drive the drops, stack cash and Rep, and don't let the Heat or the rival crews take you out.

    🕹️ Move: left stick, WASD or arrow keys
    📞 Calls: Accept a call, drive to the gold pin before the timer dies
    📦 Stash: you start with Crack ×4 and Heroin ×4 (your performance saloon's boot holds 16) — drops use stock
    🔥 Heat: drops raise it. Police chase when it's high — get caught or max it and you're arrested: custody, charges, seizures
    🏠 Safe house: Deeplish (green ring) — end the day there to cool off and re-up
    ⚔️ Rival turf: drops pay +25% but raise Tension — high Tension and a rival car may try to rob you
    🚗 Driving: steer ◀ ▶ bottom-left, pedals bottom-right — brake reverses from a standstill, handbrake + counter-steer drifts. Desktop: WASD/arrows, Space handbrake, E or F get out, H horn
    📱 Always landscape: the game runs sideways — steering left, pedals right. Hold your phone upright and it turns itself to fill the screen; there's no portrait mode

    The crews:

    Map is stylised from the real Rochdale street layout — Town Hall & River Roch in the centre, A58 west to Heywood, A680 to Norden, A640 Milnrow Road to Newbold, A671 Oldham Road south-east, Castleton & the railway south-west. Fictional game — abstract deliveries only.

    Clothes Shop · Yorkshire Street

    Buy here with Line money. Change into gear at the safe house wardrobe in Deeplish. Flex earns more, Blend keeps you invisible, Heat Risk gets you noticed.

    Used Cars · Manchester Road

    Buy motors with Line money, tweak colour / tint / alloys / exhaust. Swap cars at the safe house garage. Attention = how fast police & rivals clock you. Boot = how much stock you can carry.
